label: Workflow jobs — ideas for later
description: Job ideas not built yet, a reminder for the developers — shown behind the small light bulb of the workflows page. Edit freely: remove one once it is built.

ideas.title: Similarity — rebuild the index
ideas.text: Recompute TF-IDF + FAISS and the near-duplicate pairs; notify if new duplicates appeared. Weekly.

ideas.title: External checks on the whole library
ideas.text: YARA-X / CCCS / yaraQA for YARA, pySigma / SigmaHQ / sigmalint for Sigma, results kept per rule, report of the worst. In batches.

ideas.title: Tests on samples — run again
ideas.text: Rules changed since the last run go through rulezet-tester; new false positives / misses flagged. Needs the sandbox (not in the prod LXC yet).

ideas.title: Rules broken by an engine update
ideas.text: After a submodule / YARA / Suricata / pySigma update: validate everything again, report the rules that went from valid to invalid. Chains after 'Submodules — update'.

ideas.title: Dead references
ideas.text: Check the reference: URLs of the rules (rate-limited), flag 404 and dead domains.

ideas.title: Tokens about to expire
ideas.text: Read the expiry of GITHUB_TOKEN and the Git tokens (GitHub / GitLab API) and put a calendar reminder X days before.

ideas.title: Old API keys
ideas.text: Keys unused for N months: list them, revoke them if the option is ticked.

ideas.title: Suspicious accounts
ideas.text: Accounts created in a burst, bursts of reports / comments on one rule — to the admins.

ideas.title: Empty the trash
ideas.text: Rules soft-deleted more than N days ago deleted for good (setting), an export first.

ideas.title: Old jobs and launches
ideas.text: Purge the finished background jobs and the old workflow launch history (keep the last N).

ideas.title: Orphan files
ideas.text: Workflow attachments, old ZIP exports, temporary clones nothing points to.

ideas.title: Weekly digest by email
ideas.text: New rules, most voted, new CVEs covered — to the users who opted in.

ideas.title: Proposals waiting
ideas.text: Edit / Git proposals with no answer for N days: remind the rule owners, then the admins.

ideas.title: Reports waiting
ideas.text: Reports untreated for more than 48 h sent back to the admins.

ideas.title: New critical CVEs with no rule
ideas.text: Cross the recent high-severity CVEs (Vulnerability-Lookup) with the rules, list the gaps — a 'rules wanted' page.

ideas.title: ATT&CK coverage snapshot
ideas.text: Each month: techniques covered and by which formats, to plot the trend.

ideas.title: Connector health
ideas.text: Test every connector (reachable, key valid, version) without pulling, alert if one is down.

ideas.title: Rulesets mirror check
ideas.text: Compare the mirror repository with the database (rule count, last commit), alert on drift.
